protocol: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.1 FINAL + authoritative v0.7.1A Addendum

sources.name: MPI Leipzig Mind-Brain-Body / LEMON resting-state EEG

known_context.EEG: 62-channel resting EEG; alternating approximately one-minute eyes-closed and eyes-open blocks over approximately 16 minutes; high original sampling rate
known_context.cohort_count_warning: Do not use one universal EEG N. Primary cohort is 227; secondary EEG analyses report smaller analyzed subsets (for example 216 or 191). Atlas must reconcile release/file count and coordinate-specific usable N before numerical population.

sources.next_action: pin source version/files, reconcile EEG participant/file counts, define first native reconstruction without using age or desired state ordering

sources.name: SRM Resting-state EEG

known_context.EEG: 64-electrode BioSemi ActiveTwo, approximately four minutes eyes-closed resting EEG
known_context.repeatability: some subjects have a later repeat recording

sources.special_value: repeat recordings permit stability/reproducibility mapping without requiring a disease or outcome contrast
sources.next_action: inventory repeat-session availability and pin raw versus cleaned derivative provenance

sources.name: Resting-state EEG before and after cognitive activity across the adult lifespan and approximately 5-year follow-up

known_context.EEG: 64-channel resting-state EEG before and after a two-hour cognitive task battery
known_context.longitudinal_subset: approximately 208 participants with a roughly five-year follow-up according to current repository summary

sources.special_value: large paired pre/post perturbation source plus age and longitudinal axes that can remain metadata rather than selector inputs
sources.next_action: pin task/session labels and predeclare paired coordinate reconstruction before inspecting effect directions

sources.name: A Resting-state EEG Dataset for Sleep Deprivation

known_context.design: normal-sleep and sleep-deprivation sessions with counterbalanced session order

sources.special_value: counterbalanced within-participant physiological perturbation without requiring pathology
sources.next_action: freeze normal-sleep versus deprivation session mapping and isolate resting-state coordinate extraction from behavioral labels

sources.name: Simultaneous EEG and fMRI signals during sleep from humans

known_context.states: wakefulness and sleep with sleep-stage annotations

sources.independence_warning: sleep-stage annotations may define Atlas context but any Engine validation whose decisive windows are chosen using those labels has outcome_label independence reduced accordingly
sources.next_action: separate label-defined Atlas transition mapping from any future label-blind transition-detection qualification

sources.name: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database v1.0.0

known_context.population: pediatric subjects with intractable seizures monitored during anti-seizure medication withdrawal
known_context.montage: International 10-20 system; some records include additional/non-EEG channels
known_context.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0

sources.independence_warning: seizure onset/end annotations are valuable transition context but are NON_INDEPENDENT_FOR_ENGINE_VALIDATION on the outcome-label pathway if they select the decisive windows for an Engine seizure-transition claim
sources.next_action: build an annotation-aware Atlas context map while keeping any future label-blind transition detector on a separate prospective pathway

selection_nonclaims: No source was selected because of a reported or expected chi value.
